title: A column named in quotes is the outcome, as one in backticks
request: S9.4 live replay: embedded-007's outcome was recorded as 'The "urgent" column (0/1)...' and the card never got its column.
plan: Accept straight and curly quotes where backticks were accepted; the guard for a column only mentioned stays.

findings.defect: A column named in quotes was not read as the outcome.
findings.scenario: JH-embedded-007, Claude's arm: target 'The "urgent" column (0/1): whether the email is urgent' stayed words; the card waited on the family.
findings.fix: Quotes too, in the same places.
findings.open: Before and after: a column named and then said known later after a comma ('the `refund_at` column, known only after') is taken: the later-guard reads its own clause only.

outcome: The outcome named in quotes reaches its column.
lessons: Read the model's way of quoting as the person's: both reach the same code.
